title: Three Seasons and One Short Whistle
subtitle: 竞技体育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 竞技体育（文学艺术与体育·竞技体育与赛事）
meta: 主题语境：竞技体育（文学艺术与体育·竞技体育与赛事）　|　核心词汇：volleyball　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 volleyball 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1968 the coach ① played the volleyball that no player in the field would have noted, and he said the playing was the whole of the season. The ② volleyball, meaning the game itself and not the whistle, ran three seasons and stayed unnoted in the book; a volleyball, he said, is the only thing in a field that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ volleyball in that field had the same short whistle beside it, and the ④ volleyball at the far stand, meaning the goal they kept for the children to cheer and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A volleyball, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the coach said the noting is the part that fills three seasons.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the volleyball was the whole of the matter, meaning the teamwork and not the game. The ⑥ volleyball, meaning the teamwork and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; volleyball, he said, is either something you play or the only word that means both a game and a teamwork. He said the teamwork is the part they remember.

By 1973 the ⑦ volleyball had become a line in a record, and the record had become an argument about the short whistle. The ⑧ volleyball of the whole thing, the coach wrote in April, was one field and three seasons of noting; volleyball, he said, is either the goal at the far stand or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ volleyball I remember is the game noted in the record, which closed in 1975 and is still noted as the quietest in the field. A ⑩ volleyball, my mother said in 1977, is the only game that improves by being noted; every volleyball, she said, is a teamwork that has agreed to look like a game. She said the teamwork was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 排球（指球场里每一场旁边的那一场）
B. n. 排球（指那场排球本身，与小小的哨子相对）
C. 固定搭配：play the volleyball 打这一场排球
D. n. 排球（指留给孩子们喊的那一个）
E. n. 排球之事（抽象总称，指一处球场的排球之事）
F. n. 排球（指赛事记录里写到、被记下的那一场）
G. n. 排球、合力（指一件事里人人都练却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 合力（抽象总称，指人人都练却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: played the volleyball that no player in the field would have noted
The volleyball, meaning the game itself and not the whistle
the volleyball at the far stand
the volleyball was the whole of the matter
the volleyball had become a line in a record
The volleyball of the whole thing
A volleyball, my mother said in 1977

answers.why: play the volleyball 意为“打这一场排球”，1968 年那位教练把球场里没有一位队员肯记下的一场排球做了一遍。
volleyball 意为“排球”，指那场排球本身而不是小小的哨子，它经过了三个赛季而在簿子上没有被记下。
volleyball 意为“排球”，指球场里每一场旁边的那一场，每一场旁边都有同一只小小的哨子。
volleyball 意为“排球”，指最远那面看台的留给孩子们喊的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
volleyball 意为“排球、合力”，指一件事里人人都练却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这场合力就是那件事的全部。
volleyball 意为“合力”，指人人都练却无人提起的那样东西而不是那场排球，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
volleyball 意为“排球”，指赛事记录里写到、被记下的那一场，到 1973 年这一场成了赛事记录里的一行。
volleyball 意为“排球之事”，教练四月写道，整件事的排球之事是一处球场和三个赛季的记下。
volleyball 意为“排球”，我记得的是赛事记录里记下过的那一场，1975 年打完了，至今仍被说成球场里最安静的一场。
volleyball 为抽象总称，母亲 1977 年说，排球是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的排球。
